Citing assignees (excluding UNIV CALIFORNIA itself) that cited patents assigned to UNIV CALIFORNIA, together with the full title of the primary CPC subclass associated with each citation:

1. CALIFORNIA INST OF TECHN (publication US-2005165588-A1, citing UC patent US-6237292-B1)
   - CPC subclass G01V: GEOPHYSICS; GRAVITATIONAL MEASUREMENTS; DETECTING MASSES OR OBJECTS; TAGS

2. BLOOM ENERGY CORP (publication US-10615444-B2, citing UC patent US-6767662-B2)
   - CPC subclass H01M: PROCESSES OR MEANS, e.g. BATTERIES, FOR THE DIRECT CONVERSION OF CHEMICAL ENERGY INTO ELECTRICAL ENERGY

3. CRYSTAL IS INC (publication US-9447521-B2, citing UC patent US-2010025717-A1)
   - CPC subclass C30B: SINGLE-CRYSTAL GROWTH; UNIDIRECTIONAL SOLIDIFICATION OF EUTECTIC MATERIAL OR UNIDIRECTIONAL DEMIXING OF EUTECTOID MATERIAL; REFINING BY ZONE-MELTING OF MATERIAL; PRODUCTION OF A HOMOGENEOUS POLYCRYSTALLINE MATERIAL WITH DEFINED STRUCTURE; SINGLE CRYSTALS OR HOMOGENEOUS POLYCRYSTALLINE MATERIAL WITH DEFINED STRUCTURE; AFTER-TREATMENT OF SINGLE CRYSTALS OR A HOMOGENEOUS POLYCRYSTALLINE MATERIAL WITH DEFINED STRUCTURE; APPARATUS THEREFOR

4. SCHOWALTER LEO J (publication US-9437430-B2, citing UC patent US-2010025717-A1)
   - CPC subclass H01L: SEMICONDUCTOR DEVICES NOT COVERED BY CLASS H10

Method: Identified all 169 publications assigned to UNIV CALIFORNIA in publicationinfo, extracted their publication numbers, and found all publications whose citation lists reference those numbers. Four citing publications were found, none assigned to UNIV CALIFORNIA. For each citing publication, the primary CPC code(s) (entries flagged "first": true) were mapped to their subclass (first 4 characters of the code), and the full subclass titles were retrieved from the cpc_definition table.
